items.finding: The source states that the temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback when measuring aqueous solutions in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary.
items.how_it_applies: This supports pairing the NIR probe with temperature control or measurement, and suggests testing whether sample temperature variation over the process range shifts the sucrose signal enough to matter.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The statement is general to aqueous NIR/MIR measurement, not specific to sucrose or to an in-line pipe probe, and tempered sample holders are a laboratory measure rather than an in-line sensor.

citation.quote: Additionally, the temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary [29].
citation.label: E02 ¶12

items.finding: The source describes product temperature measurement as a method to monitor a process and obtain the process parameters needed by mathematical models for in-line or off-line optimization.
items.how_it_applies: This suggests an in-line temperature reading can feed a model-based correction, so a thermocouple or contactless device could be considered as the auxiliary temperature sensor.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The work concerns lab-scale freeze-drying of sucrose and PVP solutions, not a flowing pipe, and only the abstract is available, so no uncertainty figures or in-line pipe conditions are given.

citation.quote: The measurement of product temperature is one of the methods that can be adopted, especially in the pharmaceutical industry, to monitor the freeze-drying process and to obtain the values of the process parameters required by mathematical models useful for in-line (or off-line) optimization.
citation.label: E05 ¶1

items.finding: The source reports that evidence on spectral fusion efficacy is inconsistent: some studies show improvements under controlled laboratory conditions, while others see limited benefit or decreased accuracy attributed to overfitting and increased model complexity.
items.how_it_applies: This supports the plan to keep each block's own calibration and diagnostics and to drop the extra instrument unless the fused model beats the best single method on held-out batches.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The evidence comes from soil samples measured with vis-NIR and MIR on a bench, a different matrix, instrument and application than sucrose in an aqueous process stream.

citation.quote: While some studies report substantial improvements in SOC prediction accuracy through vis-NIR-MIR fusion under controlled laboratory conditions [14,15], others observe limited benefits or even decreased accuracy in soil classification tasks, attributed to overfitting and increased model complexity [16].
citation.label: E04 ¶4

items.finding: The source found that direct concatenation created scale imbalance and that MIR-derived wavelengths dominated the fused model (about 80 percent of selected features), overwhelming the vis-NIR contribution.
items.how_it_applies: This supports block scaling so neither method dominates, and suggests checking the per-block feature or weight distribution of the fused model for one block overwhelming the other.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The imbalance arose in soil spectra combining reflectance and absorbance units on a bench instrument; the cause and degree of imbalance may differ for NIR transmission and MIR ATR on an aqueous stream.

citation.quote: The dominance of MIR-derived wavelengths in fused models (approximately 80 percent of selected features from MIR; Table 6) indicates that the MIR signal effectively overwhelmed the vis-NIR contribution, preventing complementary information integration.
citation.label: E04 ¶34

items.finding: The source notes that an optical fiber system can be used to reduce the influence of heat development of the globar.
items.how_it_applies: This indicates fiber coupling is a known practice in FTIR setups, so a fiber link is plausible, but the source gives no length, so the required run length still needs its own test.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: No fiber length, attenuation, connector or spectrometer details are given, and the setup differs from the intended MIR probe and analyser arrangement.

citation.quote: In order to reduce the influence of heat development of the globar, an optical fiber system can be used.
citation.label: E01 ¶33
